item.title: SKADI 1.0.0-beta.23
item.description:
SKADI 1.0.0-beta.23 — Clearer connection errors

Built by the coordinated release factory from one tag: Windows, Linux, LG webOS and the Android TV beta APK on GitHub, plus the Fire OS APK for Amazon Live App Testing.

Main changes

  • Connection errors explain themselves (Android TV / Fire OS / desktop): a refused HTTPS handshake (expired certificate, wrong device clock, outdated certificate store) now reads "certificat HTTPS invalide" instead of "Erreur inconnue", with a short diagnostic code under the message. The code never contains server addresses or tokens.
  • "Envoyer le diagnostic" on the connection error screen: it turns crash reporting on, like the privacy setting, and sends the failure. Unexplained session failures are also reported when crash reporting is already on.
  • Android TV / Fire OS: signing out from the TV profile no longer crashes the app.
  • Full details in CHANGELOG.md.

Version and distribution

  • Product version 1.0.0-beta.23, build 57; webOS package version 1.0.57.
  • Android versionCode 57, strictly greater than beta.22 (56). Identifier com.skadi.client and release signing unchanged.
  • GitHub release (arthoriouss/skadi-releases): Windows installer and portable ZIP, Linux .deb, .tar.gz, .rpm and Flatpak, webOS IPK, Android TV beta APK, release-index.json and SHA256SUMS.txt. Windows updates through WinSparkle (appcast.xml).
  • Fire OS: private Actions artifact skadi-fireos-amazon-v1.0.0-beta.23 (APK), uploaded by hand to Amazon Live App Testing as a new version of the existing test.
  • Google Play (Android TV): the store AAB is built locally with scripts/windows/build-android-tv-release.ps1 (production channel, com.skadi.client) and uploaded to the internal testing track; the factory APK is the sideload beta (com.skadi.client.beta).

Qualification and limits

  • The webOS IPK is the sideload package; LG Content Store submission stays manual.
